$comment: QA-NIGHT-1 — known bugs, matched to findings so the morning summary lists them apart from NEW ones. Seeded 2026-10-28 from the bug log's open items that a reconciler can hit (mirror stamp 2026-10-20 02:20Z, so entries after BUG-453 come from QA-6/QA-7's own records). A finding is known when its signature matches `signature` (a regex) and, when given, its detail matches `detail`. Add a row when a night's NEW finding is minted. When the bug is fixed, set "status": "fixed" (and "fixedIn"): a finding that still matches it is REGRESSED, reported in its own section as high, and moves the exit code (QA-NIGHT-2 D).
